input.deck_text: The ePlane Company builds electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) for short-range intracity travel. Founded in 2016, the company was incubated at IIT Madras and grew out of a combustion research lab. Our focus is electric aerial mobility, bringing vertical take-off and landing to urban journeys. Our technology spans eVTOL aircraft and UAVs designed for short trips within cities. Leadership: Pranjal Mehta, Chief Executive Officer, and Satyanarayanan Chakravarthy, Chief Technology Officer. Both founders have worked on this problem for years, combining commercial operations experience with deep technical expertise in aerospace engineering.

input.deck_text: Petalry is a direct-to-consumer skincare brand selling through its own website and online marketplaces. Founded about 18 months ago, we now receive a few thousand orders each month. Our brand has built a strong following on Instagram, where we share products, routines and customer stories. We sell direct to consumers, giving us a relationship with every customer who buys from us. Our founder, Anika Rao, brings brand management experience from a large FMCG company and leads our brand and creative work. We are at pre-seed stage and growing across our site and marketplaces.

input.deck_text: Unbox Robotics builds compact, AI-assisted robotic package-sorting systems for the warehouses and fulfilment centres of e-commerce and logistics companies. Founded in 2019 and based in Pune, India, we design systems that sort packages automatically inside busy fulfilment operations. We work directly with customers on pilot deployments at specific sites, learning what happens on the warehouse floor and refining the machine before rollout. Our founders split responsibilities clearly: Pramod Ghadge leads the company as CEO, while Shahid Memon leads the technology as CTO and builds the machine. Our focus is hardware that fits into existing warehouse workflows and converting pilots into full deployments with logistics operators. We are growing our team in Pune and developing our enterprise sales approach with large procurement teams.

input.deck_text: HopBox delivers groceries and daily essentials in under ten minutes from small dark stores. We currently operate in one city neighbourhood cluster, with orders fulfilled from local stores close to customers. Our founders, Varun Malhotra and Dev Sethi, previously worked as operations managers at a quick-commerce company, where they managed picking times, rider utilisation and wastage by category. We apply that operating experience to a single-cluster model built around speed and local density. Customers choose essentials in a simple app ordering flow, and riders deliver within ten minutes. We are at pre-seed stage and are seeking funding to expand our dark store network and grow our customer base in the current cluster.

input.deck_text: Wint Wealth is a fintech platform that makes bond-market products accessible to retail users in India. Our focus is fixed income, bringing bonds to individuals who want to understand and access them. Our early work was hands-on. Our founders spoke directly with prospective users, explained how bonds work, and ran a basic lead-generation website. Transactions were arranged by hand, and the founding team joined introductory calls personally. That customer-first approach continues to shape how we build the platform. Our founder and CEO, Ajinkya Kulkarni, leads the company alongside co-founders who worked directly with the first users. We are at an early stage, focused on learning from every customer conversation as we grow our platform and our user base.

input.deck_text: CampusCredit provides buy-now-pay-later and small-ticket credit for college students. Our fintech product targets the student credit market, where students need small, short-term credit for everyday purchases. We underwrite applications using parent co-signer data, which gives us a second source of information beyond the student alone. Campus ambassador networks drive our distribution, bringing the product directly to students on their own campuses. For the lending licence and balance sheet, we work with an NBFC partner. We are a pre-seed company. Our founding team is Rohan Iyer, a recent engineering graduate, and his classmate, who serves as CTO. Together they are building the product, the underwriting approach, and the campus distribution engine that connects students to credit.

input.deck_text: Giva is an online-first fine silver jewellery brand, founded in 2019. We sell directly to customers, building our business around gifting occasions and repeat purchase. Having started in fine silver, we are expanding into gold and lab-grown diamonds and building an offline presence alongside our online store. We track customer acquisition cost by channel, return rate and the share of revenue from repeat customers, and we manage product margin closely. Our aim is to build a lasting jewellery brand that earns customers through product and gifting.

input.deck_text: AeroDrop is developing autonomous drone delivery of medical supplies and small parcels over short distances. We have a working prototype and have completed a handful of demonstration flights. Our flight systems are led by Dr. Meera Kapoor, an aerospace PhD with a strong research record. Our operations co-founder joined the team recently and leads day-to-day operations. Our focus is short-distance routes where fast, reliable delivery of medical supplies and small parcels matters most. We are raising a pre-seed round to build on the prototype, extend our demonstration flight programme, and move toward commercial operations. We welcome conversations with potential partners and early customers in medical and parcel logistics who want to explore short-distance autonomous delivery with us.

input.deck_text: SuperK is a tech-enabled grocery retail network for small towns. We partner with existing neighbourhood stores, rebranding them under the SuperK name and giving them standardised pricing, centralised supply, shared discounts and digital billing. Founded in 2020, we operate across small towns in Andhra Pradesh. Our founders spent months inside small-town stores learning how shopkeepers actually run their businesses, then built the network around those day-to-day realities. Our model helps store owners buy better, price consistently and modernise checkout without losing their local presence. We are building a retail network that small-town shoppers trust and store owners can grow with.

input.deck_text: Coinlane is a retail crypto trading app and wallet built for Indian users. Buy and sell crypto directly from your phone, with a built-in wallet to hold your assets. A fiat on-ramp lets users move rupees into crypto through our payment partner. Our user base is growing through referral campaigns that bring new traders to the platform. Our team: Siddharth Menon previously led growth at a payments company, bringing hands-on experience in scaling consumer fintech products. Our co-founder brings a blockchain engineering background and builds the core technology behind the app and wallet. We are a pre-seed company focused on making crypto trading simple and accessible for everyday Indian users.

input.deck_text: Jai Kisan provides financing to farmers and rural households for income-generating purchases such as agricultural and dairy equipment. Founded in 2017 and based in Mumbai, we reach borrowers through channel-partner locations across multiple districts. We registered and assessed thousands of farmers before scaling our lending, starting with the borrower rather than the app. Our platform combines local partner access with digital lending workflows to serve rural households. As our lending grows, we are building out credit assessment capability and collections processes, and aligning repayment schedules with monsoon and crop cycles.

input.deck_text: Prepnest is a mobile-first test-preparation app for competitive exams. Students learn through video lessons and adaptive practice in one app built for phone study. Our early download numbers are strong, showing clear demand from exam candidates. Our content is led by Neha Bhatt, a former teacher with a popular online following, who teaches every lesson with real audience engagement.
